detail.longDescription: Pinning actions/checkout to a SHA can switch off GitHub's new fork-checkout guard. The check lives in the action, backported July 20 (v4.4.0, v5.1.0, v6.1.0). checkout@v4 gets it; a SHA for v4.3.0 runs the old code unchecked, per Wiz. GitHub's Dec 2 pull_request_target block covers only public repos with no opt-in, so private repos and opt-ins still rely on that guard. https://www. wiz.io/blog/github-actions-sec urity-pwn-request-reckoning # GitHubActions # DevOps # Cybersecurity
